_comment: The amphora-sync cron is PAUSED (2026-08-11). In production it reports every return as changed on every run, although the statuses it wrote are in the database and the same decision no-ops when replayed locally against the same data. Harmless while nothing is RECEIVED — collectionScheduled is disarmed by the stored locator — but returnReceived is guarded ONLY by that comparison, so the first return to reach RECEIVED would email the customer every 15 minutes. Three returns are PROCESSING_WAREHOUSE, one step away. Restore the schedule below once the read is understood and a durable guard is in place.
